Actuarial.name: Translate pricing signals into proposed appetite tiers
Actuarial.issue: Wrong specialty: setting underwriting appetite tiers is an underwriting-function responsibility (e.g. Portfolio UW Manager / CUO), not the Pricing Actuary's pricing-analysis remit. No underwriting owner exists in the Actuarial division list, so this task is mis-homed.

Actuarial.name: Calibrate referral and authority thresholds to risk model
Actuarial.issue: Wrong specialty: referral/authority thresholds are underwriting authority governance owned by underwriting management, not the Pricing Actuary. Outside the actuary's documented 'does' (pricing indications/models/rate adequacy).

Actuarial.name: Post booked reserve journal entries to the general ledger
Actuarial.issue: Posting GL journal entries is clerical finance/accounting work; an actuary should not own ledger posting (specialty/seniority mismatch). Better owned by Actuarial Technician (whose does = reconcile to GL) or Finance.

Actuarial.name: Run deterministic reserve under VM-20 prescribed assumptions
Actuarial.deliverable: Deterministic reserve results by product group
Actuarial.issue: Appointed Actuary's does is opinion/oversight/governance, not hands-on calc execution. Running the deterministic reserve is routine production work; should be owned by Reserving Actuary/Actuarial Associate.

Actuarial.name: Execute stochastic reserve scenarios and compute CTE70
Actuarial.issue: Same mismatch: Appointed Actuary signs opinions, does not execute stochastic model runs. Hands-on scenario execution belongs to a Reserving/valuation actuary, not the opinion signer.

Actuarial.name: Apply stochastic and deterministic exclusion tests
Actuarial.issue: Running exclusion tests is execution work, not the Appointed Actuary's oversight/sign-off role. Should be owned by Reserving Actuary.

Actuarial.name: Measure market risk benefits at fair value
Actuarial.issue: Capital Model Actuary's does = solvency/capital/stress modeling, not GAAP valuation. MRB fair-value measurement is a reserving/valuation task; should be owned by Reserving Actuary (or ALM).

Actuarial.name: Run risk-of-material-adverse-deviation analysis
Actuarial.issue: RMAD is a reserving/Statement-of-Actuarial-Opinion concept, not capital/solvency modeling. Wrong specialty; should be owned by Reserving Actuary or Appointed Actuary.

Actuarial.name: Extract paid and incurred loss transactions by accident period
Actuarial.issue: Junior owner (Analyst) on non-trivial work; data extraction is the Actuarial Technician's documented job, so the IC owner should be the Technician here.

Actuarial.name: Reconcile triangle totals to the general ledger and claims system
Actuarial.issue: Junior owner (Analyst); GL/claims reconciliation is explicitly the Actuarial Technician's documented task.

Actuarial.name: Build cumulative paid, incurred and count development triangles
Actuarial.issue: Junior owner (Analyst) on non-trivial work; triangle compilation is the Actuarial Technician's core duty.

Actuarial.name: Screen triangle data for anomalies and outlier transactions
Actuarial.issue: Junior owner (Analyst) on non-trivial analytical work.

Actuarial.name: Document triangle data sources, assumptions and adjustments
Actuarial.issue: Junior owner (Analyst); routine documentation of data sources aligns to the Actuarial Technician's documented task.

Actuarial.name: Compute actual-versus-expected reserve runoff for the quarter
Actuarial.issue: Junior owner (Analyst) on non-trivial actual-vs-expected analysis; better owned by the Reserving Actuary.

Actuarial.name: Analyze quarterly link-ratio movement versus selected factors
Actuarial.issue: Junior owner (Analyst); selecting/analyzing link ratios vs selected factors is qualified-actuary judgment, better owned by the Reserving Actuary.

Actuarial.name: Prepare reserve monitoring exhibits for the quarterly review
Actuarial.issue: Junior owner (Analyst); routine exhibit preparation maps to the Actuarial Technician's documented task of updating reserve exhibits.

Actuarial.name: Identify large and complex claims exceeding the loss threshold
Actuarial.issue: Junior owner (Analyst) on non-trivial work; though Loss Reserving Analyst's 'does' covers large-loss analysis, the title is a junior IC role per the seniority rule.

Actuarial.name: Separate large losses from attritional triangles for analysis
Actuarial.issue: Junior owner (Analyst) on non-trivial reserving work.

Actuarial.name: Quantify prior-year reserve development by accident year
Actuarial.deliverable: Prior-year development summary by accident year
Actuarial.issue: Junior owner (Analyst) on non-trivial PY development quantification; better owned by the Reserving Actuary.

Actuarial.l4: Claims Closure Rate & Open Inventory Analysis
Actuarial.name: Build claim closure and reopening rate triangles by cohort
Actuarial.issue: Junior owner (Analyst); triangle building maps to the Actuarial Technician's documented work.

Actuarial.l4: Claims Closure Rate & Open Inventory Analysis
Actuarial.name: Analyze open claim inventory aging and settlement velocity
Actuarial.issue: Junior owner (Analyst) on non-trivial analytical work.

Actuarial.l4: Claims Closure Rate & Open Inventory Analysis
Actuarial.name: Reconcile closure metrics to claims department reporting
Actuarial.issue: Junior owner (Analyst); routine reconciliation maps to the Actuarial Technician's documented reconciliation duties.

Actuarial.name: Derive cost-of-capital charge for internal transfer pricing
Actuarial.issue: Specialty mismatch: Pricing Actuary's 'does' is product/rate-adequacy pricing, not capital. Cost-of-capital/transfer pricing is a capital function; Capital Model Actuary (only a participant) should own it.

Actuarial.name: Reconcile policy and claims extracts to source-system control totals
Actuarial.issue: Junior Analyst owns operational reconciliation; this is Actuarial Technician work (reconcile/validate data), not the Analyst's IBNR/reserving specialty.

Actuarial.name: Profile inforce and loss datasets for completeness and outliers
Actuarial.issue: Junior Analyst owns hands-on data profiling/quality work that fits Actuarial Technician; mismatched to the reserving Analyst's specialty.

Actuarial.name: Apply approved data corrections and version the cleaned dataset
Actuarial.issue: Junior Analyst owns hands-on data correction/versioning, which is Actuarial Technician-grade operational work, not the Analyst's reserving specialty.

Actuarial.name: Track actuarial continuing-education and qualification credits
Actuarial.issue: Seniority too high: a senior Appointed Actuary owning routine CE/qualification-credit tracking; this clerical tracking should sit with a junior/admin role, not the appointed actuary.

Claims.l3key: Claims || First Notice of Loss & Intake

Claims.issue: FNOL receipt/acknowledgement is intake work owned by Claims Intake Rep, whose 'does' covers capturing FNOL and routing; Claims Adjuster's 'does' is investigation/settlement, not channel receipt. Owner mismatch on specialty/seniority.

Claims.l3key: Claims || First Notice of Loss & Intake
Claims.name: Match reported loss to existing claim or generate new claim number
Claims.deliverable: Unique claim record with dedup-checked claim number
Claims.issue: Claim matching/number generation is an intake/coordination task (Claims Intake Rep validates policy identifiers; Claims Coordinator handles routing into the system), not adjuster investigation work. Owner specialty mismatch.

Claims.l3key: Claims || First Notice of Loss & Intake
Claims.name: Validate reporter authority and minimum notice completeness
Claims.deliverable: Validated intake record flagged complete or pending-info
Claims.issue: Examiner 'does' is auditing settled claims and litigation consult, not front-end notice validation; this intake-completeness check belongs to Claims Intake Rep. Owner specialty mismatch.

Claims.l3key: Claims || First Notice of Loss & Intake
Claims.name: Capture structured loss facts via guided FNOL questionnaire
Claims.issue: FNOL fact capture is the Claims Intake Rep's core 'does' (record loss details, capture first notice of loss); Claims Adjuster owns investigation/settlement, not intake capture. Owner specialty mismatch.

Claims.l3key: Claims || First Notice of Loss & Intake
Claims.name: Record involved-party and third-party contact and insurance details
Claims.deliverable: Party register with contact and other-carrier details
Claims.issue: Recording party/contact details at intake is intake-capture work (Claims Intake Rep), not adjuster investigation; also Claims Analyst is a reporting/analytics role and does not record claim-file contact details. Owner and participant mismatch.

Claims.l3key: Claims || First Notice of Loss & Intake
Claims.name: Validate captured incident data for internal consistency and gaps
Claims.issue: Examiner 'does' is post-settlement audit/compliance, not validating freshly captured intake data; data-completeness validation belongs to intake. Owner specialty/seniority mismatch.

Claims.l3key: Claims || First Notice of Loss & Intake
Claims.name: Score initial claim severity and complexity tier
Claims.deliverable: Severity and complexity classification on the claim
Claims.issue: Initial severity/complexity triage is intake/triage work (Claims Intake Rep triages severity; Claims Coordinator triages and assigns by severity/complexity), not the Examiner's post-settlement audit scope. Owner specialty mismatch.

Claims.l3key: Claims || First Notice of Loss & Intake
Claims.name: Screen FNOL for early fraud and SIU referral indicators
Claims.deliverable: Fraud-indicator screening result with referral flag
Claims.issue: Examiner 'does' covers settled-claim audit and legal consult, not early fraud/SIU screening at FNOL; SIU roles are present as participants but the owner specialty does not match early fraud detection. Owner specialty mismatch.

Claims.l3key: Claims || First Notice of Loss & Intake
Claims.name: Assign initial loss and expense reserve at intake
Claims.deliverable: Initial reserve posting on the claim
Claims.issue: Reserve setting is the adjuster's 'does' (Claims Adjuster sets reserves; Field Claims Adjuster sets initial reserves), not the Examiner's audit scope. Owner specialty mismatch; the listed participant (Claims Adjuster) is the correct owner.

Claims.l3key: Claims || First Notice of Loss & Intake
Claims.name: Generate intake task list and customer contact SLAs on assignment
Claims.deliverable: Activated task plan with SLA due dates
Claims.issue: Generating intake task lists/SLAs on assignment is coordination/intake work (Claims Coordinator manages routing/diary/follow-up; Claims Intake Rep handles intake), not the Claims Adjuster's investigation/settlement 'does'. Owner specialty mismatch.

Claims.name: Set investigation timeline and assign responsibilities
Claims.deliverable: Investigation action plan with due dates
Claims.issue: Manager owns routine per-claim file work; setting an investigation timeline/assignments is adjuster/coordinator-level, not the Director/Manager's lead-supervise-monitor scope.

Claims.name: Match claim attributes to qualified preferred network vendor
Claims.issue: Seniority too high: routine vendor matching/dispatch is core Claims Coordinator work (triage/assign, coordinate vendors), not a Director/Manager's hands-on task.

Claims.name: Issue assignment package with scope and contact details to vendor
Claims.issue: Seniority too high: issuing routine vendor assignment packages is Claims Coordinator hands-on work, not a Director/Manager task.

Claims.name: Confirm insured contact and inspection appointment scheduling
Claims.issue: Seniority too high: confirming contact and scheduling inspections is routine Claims Coordinator/Intake work, not a Director/Manager task.

Claims.name: Re-dispatch assignment on vendor decline or non-response
Claims.issue: Seniority too high: re-dispatching declined assignments is routine Claims Coordinator follow-up, not a Director/Manager task.

Claims.name: Verify vendor credential and insurance certificate currency
Claims.issue: Seniority too high and specialty mismatch: routine credential/certificate currency checks are clerical coordinator work; Director/Manager 'does' is team leadership/oversight, not document verification.

Claims.name: Screen payees against OFAC and sanctions watchlists
Claims.issue: Owner mismatch: Claims Analyst 'does' is trend/dashboard/leakage analytics, not OFAC/sanctions screening; this compliance-control task fits Claims Processor (coverage/payee verification) or a compliance role. Junior analytics IC owning a regulatory payment control.

Claims.name: Verify payee identity and banking details for disbursement
Claims.deliverable: Validated payee and remittance instruction record
Claims.issue: Owner mismatch: payee identity/banking verification is core Claims Processor work ('verify policy coverage dates, deductibles, and payee details before issuing payments'), not the adjuster's investigate/negotiate role.

Claims.name: Generate settlement payment and select disbursement method
Claims.issue: Owner mismatch/seniority: generating payments and selecting disbursement method (check/EFT) is core Claims Processor work; the adjuster authorizes but does not own the hands-on disbursement processing. Processor is the listed owner-fit role.

Claims.name: Allocate payment to indemnity, expense, and recovery buckets
Claims.deliverable: Coded payment transaction with financial splits
Claims.issue: Owner mismatch: payment allocation/posting (indemnity/expense/recovery transactions) is Claims Processor work ('process claim payments, reserve transactions, and recovery entries'); Claims Analyst is a reporting/analytics IC, wrong specialty for transactional posting.

Claims.name: Confirm payment delivery and resolve returned or stale items
Claims.deliverable: Payment delivery confirmation and exception log
Claims.issue: Owner mismatch: confirming delivery and resolving returned/stale/NSF/reissue items is explicit Claims Processor work ('issue and track checks, EFTs, and stop-payment or reissue requests'), not the adjuster.

Claims.name: Process and disburse deductible reimbursement to insured
Claims.issue: Payment disbursement is Claims Processor's defined work (process payments/recovery entries, issue checks/EFTs); a Subrogation Specialist owning the disbursement transaction is a specialty mismatch. Processor should own this, Specialist participates.

Claims.name: Post received recovery funds to the claim ledger
Claims.issue: Posting recovery funds to the ledger is Claims Processor's core duty (process recovery entries/payment transactions in the claims system). Owner should be Claims Processor, not the Subrogation Specialist.

Claims.name: Analyze missed-recovery leakage and root causes
Claims.issue: Leakage/quality reviews and quantifying financial impact are explicitly Claims Analyst's defined work; QA/Training Manager's scope is file review and training, not recovery-leakage root-cause analytics. Owner should be Claims Analyst (already a participant).

Claims.name: Calibrate recovery detection rules from outcome data
Claims.issue: Calibrating/owning the recovery detection ruleset is a governance/strategy decision over the recovery process; assigning ownership to a junior Claims Analyst is wrong seniority. Should be owned by Claims Director / Manager or Subrogation Specialist, with Analyst supplying the outcome analysis.

Claims.name: Coordinate insured cooperation for interrogatories and deposition
Claims.issue: Claims Intake Rep is FNOL-only (capture/route first notice of loss); litigation-stage deposition/interrogatory coordination is outside its scope as a participant.

Claims.name: Quantify economic and medical damages exposure
Claims.issue: Medical/Nurse Case Manager scope is medical coordination/treatment review; quantifying economic (non-medical) damages exposure is a specialty mismatch — the Liability Claims Specialist owns damages/exposure valuation.

Claims.name: Compile FROI/SROI workers' comp regulatory filings
Claims.issue: Specialty mismatch: Examiner's 'does' is auditing settled claims for compliance, not compiling regulatory filings; reporting/filing compilation is not the Examiner's charter.

Claims.name: Assemble all-payer claims database reporting extract
Claims.issue: Specialty mismatch: data-extract/reporting work, not the Examiner's audit/compliance-review specialty; Claims Analyst (builds reports/dashboards) is the fit.

Claims.name: Investigate metric outliers and document drivers
Claims.issue: Specialty mismatch: analytics/trend investigation is the Claims Analyst's 'does' (analyze frequency/severity/cycle time, investigate adverse trends), not the Examiner's compliance-audit specialty.

Claims.name: Schedule and track continued-disability proof recertifications
Claims.deliverable: Recertification diary with due dates and follow-up tasks
Claims.issue: Seniority mismatch: routine recertification scheduling/tracking is operational hands-on work; a Director/Manager should not own it. Better owned by Claims Coordinator or Claims Examiner.

Claims.name: Audit recurring benefit payments and reconcile offset changes
Claims.deliverable: Payment audit and offset reconciliation entry
Claims.issue: Owner is a junior IC (Analyst), and the task is benefit-payment auditing/reconciliation, an adjudication/financial control activity better owned by Claims Examiner; Analyst's 'does' is trend/dashboard/leakage analytics, not per-claim payment reconciliation (specialty mismatch).

Claims.name: Capture decedent and policy details from death notification
Claims.issue: Routine FNOL/intake capture is the Claims Intake Rep's job (FNOL capture, validate policy identifiers); examiner owning data capture is over-senior for the task.

Claims.name: Issue claimant acknowledgment and beneficiary contact
Claims.deliverable: Acknowledgment letter and beneficiary outreach log
Claims.issue: Routine acknowledgment/contact is correspondence/intake work owned by Intake Rep or Coordinator, not an examiner.

Claims.name: Validate certified death certificate authenticity
Claims.issue: QA/Training Manager does file-review/quality governance, not per-claim document validation; wrong specialty as a participant on a routine adjudication step.

Claims.name: Document contestability decision and disposition
Claims.issue: Documenting a decision in the file is examiner-level work; the manager approves/escalates but routine disposition documentation should be owned by the Life Claims Examiner.

Claims.name: Release death benefit payment to elected destination
Claims.issue: Releasing/issuing payment is the Claims Processor's core function (process claim payments, issue checks/EFTs); processor should own, examiner approves.

Claims.name: Process maturity or annuitized payout and tax reporting
Claims.issue: Processing the payout and tax reporting (1099 issuance) is Claims Processor payment/transaction work; processor should own the processing step rather than the examiner.

Claims.l4: Retained Asset Account & Unclaimed Property Administration
Claims.name: Run Death Master File and lost-beneficiary searches on dormant benefits
Claims.issue: Claims Analyst is a trends/dashboard/leakage-reporting role; running DMF and lost-beneficiary searches is operational claim handling, a specialty mismatch and junior owner on non-trivial unclaimed-property work.

Claims.l4: Retained Asset Account & Unclaimed Property Administration
Claims.name: Monitor account dormancy against state escheatment timelines
Claims.issue: Coordinator handles triage/correspondence/diary tracking; monitoring statutory escheatment compliance is a compliance-grade obligation that exceeds a junior coordinator's scope.

Reinsurance.name: Calculate net retention scenarios against capital and earnings volatility
Reinsurance.deliverable: Retention scenario comparison with capital and earnings impact
Reinsurance.issue: Junior Analyst owns capital/earnings-volatility scenario analysis that drives risk-appetite — judgment-heavy strategic work; should be owned by Reinsurance Manager with Analyst supporting.

Reinsurance.name: Classify exposures into treaty-cedable versus facultative-only risks
Reinsurance.issue: Treaty-vs-facultative classification is a structuring judgment that shapes the program; a junior Analyst should not own it — Reinsurance Manager (with Facultative Specialist) is the appropriate owner.

Reinsurance.name: Model layer efficiency and gap/overlap across the program tower
Reinsurance.issue: Junior Analyst owns program-tower efficiency/gap-overlap modeling that informs structuring decisions — non-trivial analytical judgment; Manager should own with Analyst producing the model.

Reinsurance.name: Run catastrophe model to derive OEP/AEP and PML curves
Reinsurance.deliverable: OEP/AEP loss exceedance curves and key-return-period PMLs
Reinsurance.issue: Catastrophe modeling (OEP/AEP/PML) is specialized analytical work; the Reinsurance Analyst 'does' covers compiling cat-modeling data, not owning model execution/interpretation — no CAT Modeler exists in the Reinsurance role list, so this needs Manager ownership or escalation, not junior-Analyst ownership.

Reinsurance.name: Reconcile modeled output against prior-year and vendor benchmark
Reinsurance.deliverable: Cat model reconciliation and variance commentary
Reinsurance.issue: Benchmarking/reconciling modeled output is interpretive analytical judgment, not routine prep; a junior Analyst owning model validation against vendor benchmarks is too junior — Manager should own.

Reinsurance.name: Forecast ceded premium spend across the reinsurance program
Reinsurance.deliverable: Ceded premium budget forecast by treaty and layer
Reinsurance.issue: Junior Accounting Specialist owns a program-wide budget forecast; the role's 'does' is transactional (technical accounts, recoverables, settlements, reconciliations), not program budgeting — wrong seniority and wrong specialty; Reinsurance Manager should own.

Reinsurance.name: Allocate reinsurance cost to lines of business and profit centers
Reinsurance.deliverable: Reinsurance cost allocation schedule by business unit
Reinsurance.issue: Cost-allocation methodology across LOBs/profit centers is a planning decision; the Accounting Specialist's 'does' (ceded premium/loss accounts, recoverables, settlements) does not include allocation design — junior/specialty mismatch.

Reinsurance.name: Calculate net cost of reinsurance and rate-on-line by layer
Reinsurance.issue: Net cost of reinsurance and rate-on-line by layer are analytical/pricing metrics aligned to the Reinsurance Analyst's 'does' (analyze treaty structures, retentions, pricing), not the Accounting Specialist's settlement/recoverables scope — wrong specialty for the owner.

Reinsurance.name: Reassess mid-year exposure growth against modeled PML
Reinsurance.issue: Mid-year reassessment of exposure growth against modeled PML is an interpretive steering judgment; a junior Analyst should not own the reassessment decision — Manager should own with Analyst supporting.

Reinsurance.l4: Assumed Treaty Underwriting & Cedant Due Diligence
Reinsurance.name: Review cedant submission and underlying portfolio data
Reinsurance.issue: Specialty mismatch: the only underwriter-titled role is the Facultative Reinsurance Specialist, whose documented 'does' is facultative PLACEMENT (ceded/outwards), not assumed treaty underwriting. No true assumed-treaty underwriter exists in the catalog; owner is a workaround.

Reinsurance.l4: Assumed Treaty Underwriting & Cedant Due Diligence
Reinsurance.name: Assess cedant underwriting quality and claims practices
Reinsurance.issue: Specialty mismatch: Reinsurance Manager's 'does' is CEDED reinsurance strategy/placement/recoverables (buying protection), not assessing inbound cedant underwriting quality for an assumed book.

Reinsurance.l4: Assumed Treaty Underwriting & Cedant Due Diligence
Reinsurance.name: Evaluate treaty terms against assumed appetite
Reinsurance.issue: Specialty mismatch: Reinsurance Manager owns CEDED treaty placement, not evaluating treaty terms for assumed/inwards underwriting.

Reinsurance.l4: Assumed Treaty Underwriting & Cedant Due Diligence
Reinsurance.name: Run experience and exposure rating on treaty layer
Reinsurance.issue: Specialty mismatch: experience/exposure rating of a treaty layer is an actuarial/treaty-underwriting task; the Facultative Specialist's 'does' covers facultative placement and negotiation, not treaty rating, and no pricing/actuarial role is included.

Reinsurance.name: Determine signed line and written-line percentage to offer
Reinsurance.issue: Specialty mismatch: setting signed/written lines on an ASSUMED risk is inwards underwriting; Reinsurance Manager's documented scope is CEDED strategy and placement, not offering capacity on inbound business.

Reinsurance.l4: Assumed Exposure Data Ingestion & Accumulation Check
Reinsurance.name: Geocode exposures and enrich with peril hazard data
Reinsurance.issue: Owner specialty mismatch: Bordereaux Analyst's 'does' is premium/claims bordereaux receipt, mapping and reconciliation; geocoding exposures and enriching with peril hazard data is catastrophe/exposure-modeling work outside this role's documented scope (no CAT Modeler role available in Reinsurance).

Reinsurance.name: Validate risk and premium records against treaty terms and field-level rules
Reinsurance.issue: Owner is a junior analyst owning non-trivial validation; also a ceded-side role assigned to assumed/inward work (specialty mismatch). Bordereaux Analyst is the natural owner.

Reinsurance.name: Query and resolve data discrepancies with cedant data providers
Reinsurance.issue: Junior analyst owner; ceded-side role on assumed work. Chasing data-quality corrections is the Bordereaux Analyst's documented 'does'.

Reinsurance.name: Estimate IBNR using development factors and bornhuetter-ferguson method
Reinsurance.issue: IBNR estimation via Bornhuetter-Ferguson is actuarial/reserving work; a junior Reinsurance Analyst (whose 'does' is treaty renewal/placement support, not reserving) should not own it. Belongs to an actuary with reinsurance staff in support.

Reinsurance.name: Evaluate cedant credit quality and underwriting reliability
Reinsurance.issue: Counterparty credit-quality evaluation is a judgment/risk decision beyond a junior Reinsurance Analyst whose 'does' is treaty renewal/placement support; should be owned by the Reinsurance Manager (or credit/risk) with the analyst supporting.

Reinsurance.name: Score data quality of cedant bordereaux submissions over time
Reinsurance.issue: Ceded-side analyst assigned to assumed/inward cedant scoring (specialty mismatch); bordereaux data-quality scoring is the Bordereaux Analyst's documented 'does' and natural ownership.

Reinsurance.name: Draft treaty submission narrative and cover note
Reinsurance.deliverable: Submission cover note and program narrative
Reinsurance.issue: Seniority too high: drafting the submission narrative/cover note is routine submission-prep, owned by the Reinsurance Analyst per its 'prepare renewal submission packs' does; the Manager should review/own placement, not draft the pack.

Reinsurance.name: Distribute submission to target reinsurer panel
Reinsurance.issue: Seniority too high: distributing the submission to markets is administrative/analyst-level (Analyst 'supports placement negotiations, tracking quotes across markets'); Manager owning this routine task is mis-leveled.

Reinsurance.name: Verify reinsurer security against approved-market list
Reinsurance.issue: Wrong specialty/seniority: counterparty security approval is a governance/credit-control judgment owned by Reinsurance Manager (reinsurer relationship/counterparty management) or Head of Reinsurance; an Analyst should not own a security sign-off.

Reinsurance.name: Clear outstanding binding subjectivities
Reinsurance.issue: Seniority too low: clearing binding subjectivities is a placement/operational control activity owned by Reinsurance Ops Manager (operational controls) or Manager; an Analyst owning sign-off of subjectivities is mis-leveled.

Reinsurance.name: Draft full treaty wording from the executed slip
Reinsurance.issue: Wrong specialty/seniority: drafting full treaty/contract wording is specialist contract work (Wordings Coverage Specialist or Manager/legal review); not in the Reinsurance Analyst data-prep 'does', and an Analyst owning legal wording is too junior.

Reinsurance.name: Set up reinsurer shares and cession parameters
Reinsurance.issue: Wrong specialty: configuring reinsurer shares/cession parameters in the treaty record is treaty administration owned by Reinsurance Ops Manager; the Accounting Specialist's 'does' is technical accounts/recoverables/settlements, not register setup.

Reinsurance.name: Register inbound facultative submission and assign reference
Reinsurance.deliverable: Logged submission record with unique facultative reference
Reinsurance.issue: Seniority mismatch: a manager owns routine clerical intake/data-entry; should be a Reinsurance Analyst with the Ops Manager overseeing.

Reinsurance.name: Set up bound cession master data in system of record
Reinsurance.issue: Seniority mismatch: a manager owns routine hands-on master-data setup; should be a Reinsurance Analyst with Ops Manager oversight.

Reinsurance.name: Track upcoming facultative cession expiries
Reinsurance.issue: Seniority mismatch: a manager owns routine hands-on expiry tracking; should be a Reinsurance Analyst with Ops Manager oversight.

Reinsurance.name: Apply treaty cession terms to subject premium by underwriting period

Reinsurance.issue: Owner is a junior Analyst on non-trivial cession calculation work.

Reinsurance.name: Reconcile booked ceded premium to gross written premium feed
Reinsurance.issue: Owner is a junior Analyst on a non-trivial reconciliation; Accounting Specialist owns reconciliation per its 'does'.

Reinsurance.name: Extract premium and claims bordereaux data for the reporting period
Reinsurance.deliverable: Period premium and loss bordereaux dataset
Reinsurance.issue: Bordereaux receipt/extraction is the Bordereaux Analyst's core 'does'; that role should own, not merely participate. Owner Analyst is also junior.

Reinsurance.name: Format bordereaux to the EBOT/ACORD market standard layout
Reinsurance.issue: Mapping bordereaux to standard formats is the Bordereaux Analyst's specialty; wrong owner specialty, and owner Analyst is junior.

Reinsurance.name: Submit bordereaux and statement to reinsurers and brokers
Reinsurance.issue: Owner is a junior Analyst on non-trivial external submission to reinsurers/brokers.

Reinsurance.name: Resolve reinsurer queries and resubmit corrected bordereaux
Reinsurance.deliverable: Query resolution log and corrected bordereaux
Reinsurance.issue: Chasing corrections/resubmissions is the Bordereaux Analyst's 'does'; wrong owner specialty, and owner Analyst is junior.

Reinsurance.name: Compile earned premium and incurred losses for the commission period
Reinsurance.issue: Owner is a junior Analyst on non-trivial commission-period data compilation.

Reinsurance.name: Run automated validation rules across ceded cession records
Reinsurance.issue: Owner is a junior Analyst on non-trivial data-quality validation work.

Reinsurance.l4: Ceded Data Quality, Leakage Detection & Controls
Reinsurance.name: Identify unceded or under-ceded risks against treaty coverage
Reinsurance.issue: Leakage detection against treaty coverage is non-trivial analysis owned by a junior Analyst.

Reinsurance.l4: Ceded Data Quality, Leakage Detection & Controls
Reinsurance.name: Remediate identified leakage and correct cession records
Reinsurance.issue: Owner is a junior Analyst on non-trivial leakage remediation affecting financial cessions.

Reinsurance.name: Aggregate event losses against catastrophe treaty layers and retentions
Reinsurance.issue: Owner is a junior Analyst on non-trivial CAT aggregation against treaty layers/retentions; the recoveries Specialist (or Manager) should own, with Analyst supporting on the modeling.

Reinsurance.name: Reconcile modeled versus reported CAT losses for recovery planning
Reinsurance.issue: Junior Analyst owning recovery-planning reconciliation; Reinsurance Analyst's 'does' is renewal/CAT-modeling data prep, not recovery planning. Recoveries Specialist is the better owner; Analyst supports the modeled-loss reconciliation.

Reinsurance.name: Calculate ceded recoverable by applying treaty terms to the paid/outstanding loss
Reinsurance.issue: Recoverable calculation by applying treaty terms is the Reinsurance Accounting Specialist's explicit 'does' (calculate reinsurance recoverables incl. paid/case/IBNR); Accounting Specialist should own, Recoveries Specialist support.

Reinsurance.name: Estimate the present value of future ceded liabilities for the commutation
Reinsurance.issue: PV estimation of future ceded liabilities is actuarial/non-trivial valuation work; a junior Reinsurance Analyst should not own it (no actuarial 'does'). Belongs with Accounting Specialist/Manager plus actuarial, Analyst supporting.

Reinsurance.name: Maintain and validate the FX rate table
Reinsurance.deliverable: Validated FX rate master for the period
Reinsurance.issue: Seniority mismatch: maintaining a reference data table is routine hands-on data work and should sit with the Accounting Specialist (the participant), not be owned by the Ops Manager.

Reinsurance.name: Produce ceded and assumed result reporting for management
Reinsurance.issue: Wrong specialty: Reinsurance Analyst's 'does' covers treaty renewal/pricing/placement, not financial result reporting. This accounting/finance output belongs with the Accounting Specialist (listed as participant).

Reinsurance.name: Score reinsurer creditworthiness using financial and qualitative criteria
Reinsurance.issue: Reinsurance Analyst is a junior IC whose 'does' centers on treaty renewal data and placement, not counterparty credit scoring. Creditworthiness scoring is risk/credit-judgment work that fits the Reinsurance Manager (counterparty management) better; junior owner on non-trivial credit assessment.

Reinsurance.name: Submit new reinsurer for security committee approval
Reinsurance.issue: Submitting/preparing a counterparty for committee approval is routine governance-prep work; an Executive (Head of Reinsurance) owning the submission is too senior. Reinsurance Manager (placement governance, counterparty management) should own; the Head would approve, not prepare/submit.

Reinsurance.name: Score broker performance on placement and service metrics
Reinsurance.issue: Broker-panel performance scoring/governance is owned by the Reinsurance Ops Manager (panel management, service quality) per its 'does'; a junior Reinsurance Analyst (treaty renewal/placement data) owning broker performance scoring is wrong seniority and specialty. Ops Manager (here only a participant) should own.

Reinsurance.name: Assess panel diversification across reinsurers and lines
Reinsurance.issue: Assessing panel diversification/concentration strategy across the reinsurer panel is a counterparty-management decision owned by the Reinsurance Manager ('counterparty management', 'reinsurer relationship management'). The Ceded Reinsurance Analyst is a data-support role; junior owner on strategic panel assessment.

Reinsurance.name: Optimize cat layer attachment and limit configuration
Reinsurance.issue: Optimizing/deciding the cat layer structure is a structuring decision, not analyst modeling support; owner should be Retrocession Manager (analyst is an IC who models candidates, not sets the structure).

Reinsurance.name: Value outstanding reserves and IBNR for the commutation
Reinsurance.issue: Valuing outstanding reserves and IBNR is an actuarial/reserving competency; Reinsurance Analyst's 'does' is treaty/exposure analysis and renewal packs, not reserve/IBNR valuation, so this is a wrong-specialty owner.

Reinsurance.name: Map reinsurance program structure into the capital model risk feed
Reinsurance.issue: Specialty mismatch: Retrocession Manager owns retrocession strategy/placement, not capital-model program-structure mapping; this is treaty-program/ERM scope better owned by Reinsurance Manager or Reinsurance Analyst.

Reinsurance.name: Quantify net-of-reinsurance PML and capital relief
Reinsurance.issue: Junior owner on non-trivial work: net-of-reinsurance PML / capital-relief quantification is actuarial/capital-model analysis; a junior Reinsurance Analyst should support, not own (no capital actuary in the Reinsurance list, so Reinsurance Manager is the appropriate owner).

Reinsurance.name: Validate reinsurance counterparty credit inputs to ERM
Reinsurance.issue: Junior owner on non-trivial governance work: validating counterparty credit inputs to ERM is a control/sign-off activity; analyst-grade Ceded Reinsurance Analyst should support, ownership belongs with Reinsurance Manager.

Reinsurance.name: Verify risk-transfer compliance for placed treaties
Reinsurance.issue: Junior owner on non-trivial compliance work: risk-transfer (ASC 944 / risk-transfer testing) compliance sign-off for treaties is a governance judgment; analyst-grade Ceded Reinsurance Analyst should support, ownership belongs with Reinsurance Manager.

Sales, Distribution & Marketing.l3key: Sales, Distribution & Marketing || Producer Acquisition & Onboarding
Sales, Distribution & Marketing.name: Administer certification assessment and capture results
Sales, Distribution & Marketing.issue: Manager-level Territory Manager owning routine assessment administration/results capture is below their seniority; this is clerical work better owned by Channel Operations Coordinator or Distribution Specialist.

Sales, Distribution & Marketing.l3key: Sales, Distribution & Marketing || Producer Acquisition & Onboarding
Sales, Distribution & Marketing.name: Assess early submission quality and appetite alignment
Sales, Distribution & Marketing.issue: Submission quality and underwriting-appetite alignment is an underwriting/territory judgment, not distribution-analytics reporting; owner mismatch — Territory Manager (or an underwriter) should own, with the analyst supporting.

Sales, Distribution & Marketing.l3key: Sales, Distribution & Marketing || Distribution Sales Operations
Sales, Distribution & Marketing.name: Build territory-level sales plan from prior-year premium and growth targets
Sales, Distribution & Marketing.deliverable: Annual territory sales plan with premium and policy-count targets
Sales, Distribution & Marketing.issue: Owner is an Analyst (junior token) owning sales-plan creation. Building the territory sales plan is a planning/ownership task that fits the Distribution Operations Manager (who owns distribution operations/governance) better; the Analyst should support.

Sales, Distribution & Marketing.l3key: Sales, Distribution & Marketing || Distribution Sales Operations
Sales, Distribution & Marketing.name: Triage inbound producer service requests and route to owner
Sales, Distribution & Marketing.deliverable: Routed service case with assigned owner and SLA
Sales, Distribution & Marketing.issue: Seniority mismatch: triaging/routing inbound producer service requests is routine hands-on work. A manager owning this is too senior; the Channel Operations Coordinator or Broker Support Specialist should own it with the manager overseeing.

Sales, Distribution & Marketing.l3key: Sales, Distribution & Marketing || Distribution Sales Operations
Sales, Distribution & Marketing.name: Configure and maintain CRM views and templates for field sales
Sales, Distribution & Marketing.issue: Owner is a Coordinator (junior token) and the task is non-trivial system configuration of CRM views/templates. The Coordinator's 'does' covers onboarding, producer codes, and reporting, not CRM tool configuration; this is a specialty/seniority mismatch better owned by Distribution Operations Manager.

Sales, Distribution & Marketing.l3key: Sales, Distribution & Marketing || Lead Management & Conversion
Sales, Distribution & Marketing.name: Capture and record marketing consent and TCPA status
Sales, Distribution & Marketing.issue: Specialty mismatch: Producer Compliance Manager owns PRODUCER licensing/appointment compliance, not marketing/TCPA consumer-consent compliance. Operational consent capture is also routine work mis-fitted to a manager.

Sales, Distribution & Marketing.l3key: Sales, Distribution & Marketing || Lead Management & Conversion
Sales, Distribution & Marketing.name: Build and calibrate the lead scoring model
Sales, Distribution & Marketing.issue: Data Analyst is a junior IC whose 'does' is recurring reports/ad-hoc pulls/KPI monitoring — building and calibrating a scoring model is beyond that scope/seniority. Better owned by Customer Insights Lead or Sales/Distribution Analyst.

Sales, Distribution & Marketing.l3key: Sales, Distribution & Marketing || Lead Management & Conversion
Sales, Distribution & Marketing.name: Verify producer license and appetite for qualified leads
Sales, Distribution & Marketing.issue: Licensing roles cover producer licensing/appointments, not underwriting 'appetite'; appetite verification belongs to distribution/underwriting (e.g., Territory Manager / Distribution Operations Manager). Owner's 'does' only partly matches the task.

Sales, Distribution & Marketing.l3key: Sales, Distribution & Marketing || Lead Management & Conversion
Sales, Distribution & Marketing.name: Maintain integrations between CRM and distribution systems
Sales, Distribution & Marketing.issue: Maintaining system integrations is an IT/engineering task; no Sales/Distribution role's 'does' covers technical integration maintenance. This is a specialty mismatch (belongs to a technology/IT role outside this division's list).

Sales, Distribution & Marketing.l3key: Sales, Distribution & Marketing || Producer Compensation Management
Sales, Distribution & Marketing.name: Validate producer taxpayer identification and reporting eligibility
Sales, Distribution & Marketing.issue: Owner specialty mismatch: Producer Compliance Manager's remit is licensing/appointment/conduct compliance, not tax-ID/taxpayer reporting eligibility, which is a finance/commission-admin function. Commission Analyst (or a tax/finance role not in this list) is the more appropriate owner.

Sales, Distribution & Marketing.l3key: Sales, Distribution & Marketing || Partner & Channel Governance
Sales, Distribution & Marketing.name: Reconcile MGA bordereaux against booked premium and policy records
Sales, Distribution & Marketing.issue: Junior analyst owns a financial premium reconciliation; this is a financial/control task matching Commission Analyst's 'does' (reconcile commission/premium), not the analytics-focused Sales/Distribution Analyst. Specialty mismatch.

Sales, Distribution & Marketing.l3key: Sales, Distribution & Marketing || Partner & Channel Governance
Sales, Distribution & Marketing.l4: Distribution Data Quality & Master Data Governance
Sales, Distribution & Marketing.name: Remediate duplicate and conflicting producer master records
Sales, Distribution & Marketing.issue: Junior Data Analyst owns master-data remediation/merge, a stewardship/decision action. Analyst 'does' is reporting/monitoring, not data remediation; ownership belongs to the Distribution Operations Manager (owns the standards) or a data-governance steward. Seniority/specialty mismatch.

Sales, Distribution & Marketing.l3key: Sales, Distribution & Marketing || Digital & Embedded Distribution
Sales, Distribution & Marketing.name: Reconcile online-bound policies to policy admin
Sales, Distribution & Marketing.issue: Owner is an analyst role scoped to distribution analytics/reporting, not transactional policy reconciliation; reconciliation fits Channel Operations Coordinator or an AR/billing role.

Sales, Distribution & Marketing.l3key: Sales, Distribution & Marketing || Digital & Embedded Distribution
Sales, Distribution & Marketing.name: Process inbound D2C applications to bind
Sales, Distribution & Marketing.deliverable: Bound D2C policy with completed application record
Sales, Distribution & Marketing.issue: Wrong specialty: Renewal Underwriter's does is renewal/retention/repricing, not new-business D2C binding; owner mismatch for inbound new business.

Sales, Distribution & Marketing.l3key: Sales, Distribution & Marketing || Digital & Embedded Distribution
Sales, Distribution & Marketing.name: Reconcile aggregator-sourced policies and lead fees
Sales, Distribution & Marketing.deliverable: Aggregator volume and fee reconciliation statement
Sales, Distribution & Marketing.issue: Owner is a distribution-analytics/reporting role, not scoped to transactional reconciliation of policies/lead fees; Commission Analyst or Channel Operations Coordinator is the better owner.

Sales, Distribution & Marketing.l3key: Sales, Distribution & Marketing || Market & Customer Intelligence
Sales, Distribution & Marketing.name: Run clustering model to derive customer segments
Sales, Distribution & Marketing.deliverable: Segment assignment output with cluster profiles
Sales, Distribution & Marketing.issue: Junior IC owning non-trivial work, and specialty mismatch: Data Analyst 'does' is recurring reports/ad-hoc pulls/KPI monitoring, not building/running clustering models.

Sales, Distribution & Marketing.l3key: Sales, Distribution & Marketing || Market & Customer Intelligence
Sales, Distribution & Marketing.name: Analyze line-of-business growth trends and rate environment
Sales, Distribution & Marketing.issue: Junior IC (Analyst) owning non-trivial cross-LOB growth/rate-environment analysis that drives strategy; should be owned by Customer Insights Lead or Insurance Product Manager.

Sales, Distribution & Marketing.l3key: Sales, Distribution & Marketing || Market & Customer Intelligence
Sales, Distribution & Marketing.name: Benchmark competitor pricing and coverage against our offerings
Sales, Distribution & Marketing.issue: Junior IC (Product Analyst) owning non-trivial competitive pricing/coverage benchmark; specialty also leans to product-performance reporting, not competitor pricing analysis. Better owned by Market Research Analyst (whose 'does' covers competitor rate/filing tracking) or Insurance Product Manager.

Sales, Distribution & Marketing.l3key: Sales, Distribution & Marketing || Market & Customer Intelligence
Sales, Distribution & Marketing.name: Profile competitor distribution strategy and channel moves
Sales, Distribution & Marketing.issue: Junior IC owning non-trivial competitor distribution-strategy profiling; this is a strategy-grade deliverable better owned by Business Development Manager or Head of Distribution.

Sales, Distribution & Marketing.l3key: Sales, Distribution & Marketing || Market & Customer Intelligence
Sales, Distribution & Marketing.name: Engineer features from customer and policy history
Sales, Distribution & Marketing.issue: Specialty mismatch: feature engineering for a predictive model is data-science work; Data Analyst 'does' is reporting/KPI monitoring, not model feature engineering.

Sales, Distribution & Marketing.l3key: Sales, Distribution & Marketing || Market & Customer Intelligence
Sales, Distribution & Marketing.name: Train and validate propensity model on holdout sample
Sales, Distribution & Marketing.issue: Junior IC and specialty mismatch: training/validating a predictive model is not a Data Analyst capability (reports/pulls/KPI). No data-scientist role exists in this division, so ownership is wrong.

Sales, Distribution & Marketing.l3key: Sales, Distribution & Marketing || Market & Customer Intelligence
Sales, Distribution & Marketing.name: Score customer base and rank propensity deciles
Sales, Distribution & Marketing.deliverable: Scored customer file with propensity deciles
Sales, Distribution & Marketing.issue: Specialty mismatch: scoring against a trained model is data-science execution, outside Data Analyst's reporting/KPI 'does'.

Sales, Distribution & Marketing.l3key: Sales, Distribution & Marketing || Market & Customer Intelligence
Sales, Distribution & Marketing.name: Build churn-risk model to flag at-risk policyholders
Sales, Distribution & Marketing.issue: Junior IC and specialty mismatch: building a churn-risk model is data-science work, not the Data Analyst's reporting/KPI 'does'.

Sales, Distribution & Marketing.l3key: Sales, Distribution & Marketing || Market & Customer Intelligence
Sales, Distribution & Marketing.name: Quantify customer lifetime value by segment
Sales, Distribution & Marketing.issue: Specialty mismatch / junior on non-trivial work: CLV modeling is analytic-modeling work beyond the Data Analyst's reporting/KPI 'does'; better owned by Customer Insights Lead.

Sales, Distribution & Marketing.l3key: Sales, Distribution & Marketing || Brand, Content & Demand Generation
Sales, Distribution & Marketing.name: Produce and copy-edit content assets to brand voice
Sales, Distribution & Marketing.deliverable: Final content asset package (copy and creative)
Sales, Distribution & Marketing.issue: Specialty mismatch: Digital Marketing Specialist's 'does' is paid/digital campaign execution and funnel optimization, not editorial copy production/copy-editing. Content production sits under Marketing Manager (oversees content production) / Marketing Coordinator (collateral library).

Sales, Distribution & Marketing.l3key: Sales, Distribution & Marketing || Marketing Operations, Analytics & Compliance
Sales, Distribution & Marketing.name: Provision marketing automation user roles and permissions
Sales, Distribution & Marketing.issue: Owner mismatch: Digital Marketing Specialist 'does' is campaign execution, funnels and A/B tests, not platform administration/identity provisioning. No martech-admin role exists in this division; this is misassigned.

Sales, Distribution & Marketing.l3key: Sales, Distribution & Marketing || Marketing Operations, Analytics & Compliance
Sales, Distribution & Marketing.name: Configure lead capture and routing integrations between web forms and CRM
Sales, Distribution & Marketing.issue: Owner mismatch: integration configuration is system/martech-admin work, not the Digital Marketing Specialist's campaign-execution remit.

Sales, Distribution & Marketing.l3key: Sales, Distribution & Marketing || Marketing Operations, Analytics & Compliance
Sales, Distribution & Marketing.name: Apply martech vendor releases and validate in sandbox before production
Sales, Distribution & Marketing.issue: Owner mismatch: release management/sandbox validation is platform-admin work, outside the Digital Marketing Specialist's campaign skillset.

Sales, Distribution & Marketing.l3key: Sales, Distribution & Marketing || Marketing Operations, Analytics & Compliance
Sales, Distribution & Marketing.name: Monitor martech platform uptime and resolve integration failures
Sales, Distribution & Marketing.issue: Owner mismatch: uptime monitoring and integration-failure resolution is an infrastructure/ops function, not the Digital Marketing Specialist's campaign role.

Sales, Distribution & Marketing.l3key: Sales, Distribution & Marketing || Marketing Operations, Analytics & Compliance
Sales, Distribution & Marketing.name: Synchronize segmented audiences from the data warehouse to activation platforms
Sales, Distribution & Marketing.issue: Owner mismatch: data-warehouse-to-platform syncing is a data/integration task; the Data Analyst (a participant) fits far better than the Digital Marketing Specialist whose remit is campaign execution.

Sales, Distribution & Marketing.l3key: Sales, Distribution & Marketing || Marketing Operations, Analytics & Compliance
Sales, Distribution & Marketing.name: Maintain advertising review log and approved-materials register
Sales, Distribution & Marketing.issue: Seniority too high: maintaining a register/log is routine clerical record-keeping; the Marketing Coordinator (the participant) should own it, not the Producer Compliance Manager.

Sales, Distribution & Marketing.l3key: Sales, Distribution & Marketing || Marketing Operations, Analytics & Compliance
Sales, Distribution & Marketing.name: Track conduct remediation actions through to closure
Sales, Distribution & Marketing.issue: Participant mismatch: tracking conduct remediation is a compliance/distribution function; the Marketing Coordinator has no role in producer-conduct remediation and is the wrong participant here.

Underwriting.name: Confirm submission good-order and release to underwriting
Underwriting.issue: Releasing a submission into underwriting is a good-order gate/triage decision; Submission Intake Specialist (whose 'does' explicitly covers triage and routing to the underwriting team) is the natural owner. A Technician (rating/issuance per instruction) lacks the triage mandate for this gating decision.

Underwriting.name: Record declination outcome and update appetite analytics
Underwriting.deliverable: Closed declined submission with coded reason
Underwriting.issue: Updating appetite analytics is portfolio/analytical work, not the Technician's mandate (rating, issuance docs, ordering reports per underwriter instruction). Owner should be Underwriting Analyst / Associate (whose 'does' covers exposure analysis and underwriting workflow/analytics) with the Technician recording the raw outcome.

Underwriting.name: Track outstanding requirements and follow up to good order
Underwriting.issue: Operations manager owning routine requirement-tracking/follow-up; this clerical chase belongs to the Technician/Assistant, not a manager.

Underwriting.name: Screen reinsurance treaty and refer over-retention cases
Underwriting.issue: Treaty screening / over-retention referral is the ceding underwriter's job; facultative role's 'does' is facultative placement, not treaty cession screening - specialty mismatch.

Underwriting.name: Validate rate against filed rates and minimum-premium rules
Underwriting.issue: Specialty mismatch: Premium Auditor validates auditable exposure/earned premium post-bind, not filed-rate compliance at pricing; this validation fits the Technician/Underwriter or Pricing Actuary.

Underwriting.name: Log appetite exception with class, reason, and approver
Underwriting.issue: Specialty mismatch: Delegated Authority Analyst is scoped to coverholder/binding-authority bordereaux breaches, not direct-underwriting appetite exception logging. Owner should be Underwriting Analyst / Associate or Underwriting Assistant.

Underwriting.name: Verify premium payment and warranty compliance
Underwriting.issue: Specialty mismatch: Premium Auditor validates post-policy auditable exposure/earned premium, not pre-bind payment/warranty checks. Belongs to underwriter or UW technician.

Underwriting.name: Lock bound transaction and create system policy of record
Underwriting.issue: Seniority mismatch: locking the transaction and creating the system policy of record is routine hands-on processing, work for the Underwriting Technician, not the ops manager who owns workflow/SOPs.

Underwriting.name: Confirm delivery requirements and place policy in force
Underwriting.issue: Seniority mismatch: placing the policy in force is a routine hands-on transaction (technician-level), not work for the ops manager who owns workflow/SOPs.

Underwriting.name: Compile underwriting file with rationale and exceptions
Underwriting.issue: Junior role on judgment work / specialty mismatch: documenting underwriting rationale and exceptions is the underwriter's responsibility; Technician 'does' is rating/processing, not authoring underwriting judgment.

Underwriting.name: Verify statutory notice period and content requirements
Underwriting.issue: Specialty/seniority mismatch: QA/Audit Manager's 'does' is UW quality assurance, file audit, and authority governance, not per-transaction statutory notice verification. A department QA/audit manager owning a routine regulatory-notice check is wrong altitude; this is a compliance/ops task.

Underwriting.name: Process return premium and close policy record
Underwriting.deliverable: Cancellation settlement and closed policy record
Underwriting.issue: Specialty mismatch: Premium Auditor's 'does' is validating auditable exposure and calculating final auditable premium at audit, not processing return premium or closing policy records. Returning premium and closing the record is billing/technician work (Underwriting Technician's 'does' covers cancellations and policy processing).

Underwriting.name: Collect outstanding premium and apply reinstatement terms
Underwriting.issue: Specialty mismatch: collecting outstanding premium is a billing/collections task, not premium audit. Premium Auditor's 'does' (validate auditable exposure, calculate final auditable premium) does not cover premium collection; an Underwriting Technician or billing role fits.

Underwriting.name: Collect coverholder application pack and supporting documentation
Underwriting.deliverable: Completed coverholder due-diligence questionnaire and document file
Underwriting.issue: Routine intake/collection work; better owned by Coverholder Coordinator. Delegated Authority Manager is over-senior for document collection.

Underwriting.name: Verify producer licensing and regulatory standing of the MGA
Underwriting.deliverable: License verification and regulatory background report
Underwriting.issue: Specialty mismatch: licensing/regulatory verification is not the QA/Audit Manager's 'does' (file audit/authority governance). Better owned by Coverholder Coordinator or Delegated Authority Manager.

Underwriting.name: Assess MGA financial stability and operational capability
Underwriting.deliverable: Financial and operational capability assessment memo
Underwriting.issue: Specialty mismatch: Premium Auditor validates exposure/earned-premium accuracy, not MGA financial-stability/counterparty due diligence. Belongs to Delegated Authority Manager.

Underwriting.name: Receive and log incoming risk and premium bordereaux
Underwriting.issue: Routine intake/logging; over-senior owner. Coverholder Coordinator (tracks bordereaux deadlines) or Delegated Authority Analyst should own this hands-on task.

Underwriting.name: Validate bordereaux data quality and completeness
Underwriting.issue: Specialty mismatch: bordereaux data-quality validation is the Delegated Authority Analyst's core 'does', not the Premium Auditor's (exposure/earned-premium audit).

Underwriting.name: Raise and resolve bordereaux queries with the coverholder
Underwriting.issue: Routine query chasing; over-senior owner. Coverholder Coordinator (chases late/incomplete reporting) or Analyst should own; manager only on escalation.

Underwriting.name: Post validated bordereaux to the policy and premium records
Underwriting.deliverable: Booked bordereaux premium and risk entries
Underwriting.issue: Routine data-posting; over-senior owner. Belongs to Delegated Authority Analyst or Underwriting Technician, not the operations manager.

Underwriting.name: Compile binder loss-ratio and premium performance metrics
Underwriting.issue: Specialty mismatch: monitoring loss ratios/rate adequacy against binder terms is the Delegated Authority Analyst's 'does', not the Premium Auditor's.

Underwriting.name: Reconcile final bordereaux and outstanding premium balances
Underwriting.issue: Specialty mismatch: bordereaux/premium-balance reconciliation against binder terms is Delegated Authority Analyst (or a Reinsurance Accounting Specialist) work, not the Premium Auditor's exposure-audit remit.

Underwriting.name: Geocode in-force exposures and validate location data
Underwriting.issue: Owner specialty mismatch: Delegated Authority Analyst's 'does' is coverholder/bordereaux/binder oversight, not catastrophe exposure geocoding. A CAT/exposure analyst or Underwriting Analyst / Associate fits better.

Underwriting.name: Aggregate total insured value by catastrophe zone
Underwriting.issue: Participant mismatch: Delegated Authority Analyst handles binder/coverholder exposure, not catastrophe-zone TIV aggregation; not the right specialty for this CAT task.

Underwriting.name: Compare zonal accumulation against approved capacity limits
Underwriting.issue: Participant mismatch: Delegated Authority Analyst's remit is delegated-authority/binder compliance, not zonal accumulation vs capacity.

Underwriting.name: Reconcile ceded premium against treaty proportions
Underwriting.issue: Owner specialty mismatch: ceded-premium reconciliation is a Reinsurance Accounting/Ceded Reinsurance function, outside the Underwriting Analyst / Associate 'does' (submission triage/exposure/quote support). No reinsurance-accounting role is on the Underwriting list, so this likely belongs to the Reinsurance division.

Underwriting.name: Generate reinsurance recovery position for the program
Underwriting.issue: Owner specialty mismatch: reinsurance recovery position is a recoveries/accounting function (Reinsurance Claims / Recoveries or Reinsurance Accounting Specialist), not within Underwriting Analyst / Associate 'does'.

Underwriting.name: Test authority-limit adherence on bound risks
Underwriting.issue: Audit testing of authority adherence is owned by Underwriting Quality / Audit Manager (does: file audit, authority governance). A Senior Underwriter testing bound risks breaks auditor independence and is a specialty mismatch.

Underwriting.name: Verify regulatory and KYC documentation completeness in files
Underwriting.issue: Compliance/KYC documentation testing within an audit engagement belongs to the Underwriting Quality / Audit Manager, not a Senior Underwriter whose 'does' is risk assessment/pricing/negotiation; owner is a specialty mismatch (no auditor independence).

Underwriting.name: Validate surplus lines tax and data filing submissions
Underwriting.issue: Surplus lines tax and statutory data filing is an operations/compliance task, not core Senior Underwriter work (risk assessment, pricing, negotiation). Wrong specialty for owner; belongs to UW Operations Manager or compliance/technician function.

Business Operations.name: Perform new-issue quality audit and clear exceptions
Business Operations.issue: QA Analyst (Service) does = scoring calls/service transactions; not new-issue policy/document audit. Wrong specialty; Underwriting Quality/Audit role would fit, or this belongs to Policy Admin Ops Lead.

Business Operations.name: Evaluate nonforfeiture options when grace period expires unpaid
Business Operations.issue: Nonforfeiture option evaluation is a life-product contractual/actuarial determination; outside Policy Administrator does (setup/issuance/records). No life-policy/actuarial owner among Business Operations roles available; specialty mismatch.

Business Operations.name: Coordinate transfer of funds and surrender of the original contract
Business Operations.issue: Cash Application Specialist does = apply incoming premium payments / clear suspense, not coordinate 1035 fund transfers and contract surrender (an inter-carrier exchange/disbursement). Specialty mismatch.

Business Operations.name: Record tax-reporting attributes and confirm 1035 nontaxable treatment
Business Operations.issue: Confirming 1035 nontaxable tax treatment is a tax/compliance determination outside Policy Administrator does (policy setup/issuance/records). Specialty mismatch; no tax/compliance owner present.

Business Operations.l3key: Business Operations || Life Policy Administration & Inforce Servicing
Business Operations.name: Audit statement and illustration output for accuracy
Business Operations.issue: QA Analyst (Service) scope is scoring calls/service transactions for script/disclosure adherence, not auditing numeric statement/illustration calculation accuracy; specialty mismatch (better owned by Policy Administrator).

Business Operations.l3key: Business Operations || Life Policy Administration & Inforce Servicing
Business Operations.name: Execute conservation outreach to lapse-pending policyowners
Business Operations.issue: Operations Manager leads teams/escalations and monitors performance; owning hands-on outbound conservation calling is a seniority mismatch. Hands-on participant (Senior Contact Center Agent) should own; manager is too senior for routine outreach execution.

Business Operations.l3key: Business Operations || Life Policy Administration & Inforce Servicing
Business Operations.name: Conduct beneficiary location and outreach due diligence
Business Operations.issue: Operations Manager is a people-leader role (leads teams, manages escalations); owning hands-on beneficiary location/outreach due-diligence work is a seniority mismatch. Should be owned by a hands-on agent (e.g. Senior Contact Center Agent).

Business Operations.l3key: Business Operations || Annuity New Business & Servicing
Business Operations.name: Index and image incoming annuity application packet
Business Operations.issue: Specialty mismatch: Policy Issuance Specialist issues approved policies; indexing/imaging intake is clerical and squarely the Policy Data Entry Clerk's 'does' (index and attach documents). Owner and participant should swap.

Business Operations.l3key: Business Operations || Annuity New Business & Servicing
Business Operations.name: Key annuity application data into contract record
Business Operations.issue: Specialty mismatch: keying application data is the Policy Data Entry Clerk's core 'does' (enter new business applications); Policy Administrator administers records, not raw key-entry. Owner should be the clerk.

Business Operations.l3key: Business Operations || Annuity New Business & Servicing
Business Operations.name: Validate suitability questionnaire for completeness
Business Operations.issue: Specialty mismatch: QA Analyst (Service)'s 'does' is scoring recorded calls/transactions against quality standards, not suitability-questionnaire validation. Suitability sits with policy admin/compliance, not service-call QA.

Business Operations.l3key: Business Operations || Annuity New Business & Servicing
Business Operations.name: Screen recommendation against Reg BI suitability rules
Business Operations.issue: Specialty mismatch + seniority: Reg BI / best-interest suitability screening is a compliance judgment; no Business Operations IC owns it. Service-call QA Analyst does call-quality scoring, not regulatory suitability screening. Needs a compliance/suitability role.

Business Operations.l3key: Business Operations || Annuity New Business & Servicing
Business Operations.name: Compile best-interest rationale documentation
Business Operations.issue: Specialty mismatch: best-interest rationale is a compliance/suitability artifact; Policy Administrator's 'does' is policy setup/records, not documenting Reg BI rationale. Participant QA Analyst (Service) is also off-specialty.

Business Operations.l3key: Business Operations || Annuity New Business & Servicing
Business Operations.name: Record suitability disposition and approve to proceed
Business Operations.issue: Specialty mismatch on participant: QA Analyst (Service) handles call-quality scoring, not suitability disposition. The approval-level owner (Ops Lead) is reasonable, but the suitability/compliance specialty is absent from the team.

Business Operations.l3key: Business Operations || Annuity New Business & Servicing
Business Operations.name: Track outstanding transfer and follow up on aging requests
Business Operations.issue: Specialty mismatch: Renewal Coordinator's 'does' is renewal-cycle prep/loss runs/non-renewal notices — nothing to do with 1035 transfer follow-up. Tracking aging transfers belongs with policy admin/cash teams.

Business Operations.l3key: Business Operations || Annuity New Business & Servicing
Business Operations.name: Confirm tax-free exchange treatment and basis carryover
Business Operations.issue: Specialty mismatch: tax-free 1035 treatment and basis carryover is a tax/policy determination; AR Reconciliation Analyst's 'does' is premium-receivables reconciliation, not tax-basis confirmation.

Business Operations.l3key: Business Operations || Annuity New Business & Servicing
Business Operations.name: Reconcile subaccount unit values to fund administrator
Business Operations.issue: Specialty mismatch: AR Reconciliation Analyst reconciles premium receivables/GL, not separate-account subaccount unit values against a fund administrator. That is an investment-accounting function not covered by any Business Operations role here.

Business Operations.l3key: Business Operations || Annuity New Business & Servicing
Business Operations.name: Calculate surrender charges and free-withdrawal amount
Business Operations.issue: Specialty mismatch: surrender-charge / free-withdrawal calculation is a contract-value/policy-admin computation, not premium-receivables reconciliation. AR Reconciliation Analyst's 'does' does not cover this.

Business Operations.l3key: Business Operations || Annuity New Business & Servicing
Business Operations.name: Apply tax withholding and prepare 1099-R basis
Business Operations.issue: Specialty mismatch: tax withholding and 1099-R basis is a tax-reporting function; AR Reconciliation Analyst handles receivables reconciliation, not distribution tax reporting. No team role covers tax.

Business Operations.l3key: Business Operations || Annuity New Business & Servicing
Business Operations.name: Disburse withdrawal proceeds and confirm to owner
Business Operations.issue: Specialty mismatch: Cash Application Specialist applies inbound premium payments; outbound disbursement of proceeds is the Payment Processing Clerk's payment/refund function. Owner/participant should swap.

Business Operations.l3key: Business Operations || Annuity New Business & Servicing
Business Operations.name: Calculate required minimum distribution amount
Business Operations.issue: Specialty mismatch: RMD calculation is a tax/contract-value computation; AR Reconciliation Analyst's 'does' is premium-receivables reconciliation, not RMD math. Belongs with policy admin / a tax function.

Business Operations.l3key: Business Operations || Annuity New Business & Servicing

Data & AI.name: Peer-review transformation logic and approve to promote
Data & AI.issue: Specialty mismatch: Data Architect's 'does' is enterprise data-architecture strategy/blueprint/roadmap, not peer-reviewing ETL transformation logic and approving code promotion. That promotion gate belongs to the Data Engineer (owns the pipeline) or Data Quality Manager.

Data & AI.name: Translate logical model into physical schema with partitioning and clustering
Data & AI.issue: Specialty mismatch: producing the physical data model from a logical model is Data Modeler work ('physical data models' is explicitly in Modeler's does). DBA's does is admin/tuning/backup/access, not schema design. Data Modeler (a participant) should own this.

Data & AI.name: Apply platform patching and version upgrades through controlled change
Data & AI.issue: Specialty mismatch: patching/version upgrades are not in SRE's does (SLOs, observability, incident response). DBA explicitly owns 'patching, upgrades, and configuration'; DBA should own this task, not SRE.

Data & AI.name: Define and provision self-service workspace roles and permissions
Data & AI.issue: Specialty mismatch: Data Governance 'does' is framework/charter/operating-model definition, not hands-on provisioning of workspace roles/permissions (an IT/admin or Data Steward task).

Data & AI.l3key: Data & AI || Data Science & Model Development
Data & AI.name: Validate feature data quality and freshness post-publish
Data & AI.issue: Seniority mismatch: Data Quality Manager 'does' is framework/scorecards/remediation governance, not hands-on per-feature validation; this routine operational check belongs to an IC (Data Engineer/Data Steward), with the manager as participant.

Data & AI.l3key: Data & AI || MLOps & Model Lifecycle Management
Data & AI.name: Reconcile registry inventory against deployed serving endpoints
Data & AI.issue: Seniority too high: routine hands-on reconciliation/inventory-audit work should be owned by the ML Engineer, not a Data Science Lead.

Data & AI.l3key: Data & AI || MLOps & Model Lifecycle Management
Data & AI.name: Submit material model approval for governance committee sign-off
Data & AI.deliverable: Committee model approval and conditions record
Data & AI.issue: Seniority too high: preparing/submitting a model package for committee sign-off is routine governance work owned by the Model Risk Manager (who owns model governance and is already a participant), not an executive CDO.

Data & AI.name: Publish topology model as the dependency source-of-truth
Data & AI.issue: Specialty mismatch: Data Engineer's does covers data ingestion/transformation pipelines, not service-topology/dependency models. Topology is an AIOps/SRE artifact; AIOps Engineer (already a participant) should own.

Technology & Engineering.name: Sign off design and hand over to engineering for build
Technology & Engineering.issue: Solution Architect's 'does' explicitly includes governing solution designs and securing sign-off; the SA who produced the design (and is only a participant) is the correct owner of design sign-off here, not the Enterprise Architect.

Technology & Engineering.name: Define security scheme and scopes for the API
Technology & Engineering.issue: Participant Risk Engineer is wrong specialty: its 'does' is insurance loss-control / site surveys / fire protection, not API/cyber security. ISO Architect owner is correct.

Technology & Engineering.name: Approve API standards exception for legacy consumer
Technology & Engineering.issue: Participant Risk Engineer is wrong specialty (insurance loss-control, not technology risk). Head of IT exception approval is appropriate seniority.

Technology & Engineering.name: Validate security and authorization on integration endpoints
Technology & Engineering.issue: Owner Risk Engineer is wrong specialty: it is an insurance loss-control / site-survey role, not security. Security validation owner should be ISO Architect (the security role, currently only a participant).

Technology & Engineering.name: Set topic access controls and quotas for producers
Technology & Engineering.issue: Participant Risk Engineer is wrong specialty (insurance loss-control, not access/security). ISO Architect owner is correct for access controls.

Technology & Engineering.name: Validate inter-change dependencies and bundling constraints
Technology & Engineering.issue: Specialty mismatch: Solution Architect does end-to-end solution design and integration architecture, not release-level change dependency/bundling validation. This is release-coordination work better owned by the Release Train Engineer (already a participant).

Technology & Engineering.name: Audit pipeline deployment logs against change governance
Technology & Engineering.issue: Specialty/wrong-owner: an audit of deployment logs against change governance is a controls/assurance task. The Release Train Engineer facilitates flow and cadence; it does not own audit/controls evidence. Better owned by ISO Architect (governance/controls, already a participant) or IT Service Delivery Manager.

Technology & Engineering.name: Validate CI relationships and service dependency mappings
Technology & Engineering.issue: Specialty mismatch: Solution Architect does end-to-end solution/integration design, not CMDB CI-relationship validation, which is an ITSM/CMDB-governance task (better owned by IT Service Delivery Manager or Infrastructure Engineer).

Technology & Engineering.l3key: Technology & Engineering || Site Reliability & Production Support
Technology & Engineering.name: Isolate affected systems to contain the impact spread
Technology & Engineering.issue: Security-incident containment; the security specialist (ISO Architect, whose 'does' is pentest/security risk/exceptions) should own, not SRE.

Technology & Engineering.l3key: Technology & Engineering || Site Reliability & Production Support
Technology & Engineering.name: Preserve evidence and forensic artifacts before remediation
Technology & Engineering.issue: Forensic evidence preservation is a security specialty (ISO Architect); wrong-specialty owner for SRE whose does is SLOs/observability/incident response, not forensics.

Technology & Engineering.name: Reconcile cloud spend to the monthly provider invoice
Technology & Engineering.issue: Invoice reconciliation is a finance/AR specialty; Cloud Engineer's 'does' covers provisioning, RBAC, and tagging, not financial reconciliation.

Technology & Engineering.name: Build executive cloud cost trend dashboard
Technology & Engineering.issue: Dashboard/reporting build is not in Cloud Engineer's 'does'; Data Engineer (datasets) or an analyst owns this, not the provisioning-focused Cloud Engineer.

Technology & Engineering.name: Distribute monthly cloud cost summary to stakeholders
Technology & Engineering.issue: Specialty mismatch: IT Service Delivery Manager's 'does' is SLAs/incidents/service catalogs, not cloud cost reporting/distribution.

Technology & Engineering.name: Define mandatory cost-allocation tag taxonomy
Technology & Engineering.issue: Seniority/altitude mismatch: Enterprise Architect's 'does' is target-state roadmaps and portfolio rationalization; defining an operational tag taxonomy belongs to Cloud Architect/Cloud Engineer.

Technology & Engineering.name: Generate per-team showback statements
Technology & Engineering.issue: Generating financial showback statements is a reporting/finance task outside Cloud Engineer's 'does' (provisioning/RBAC/tagging).

Technology & Engineering.name: Reconcile chargeback amounts to the general ledger
Technology & Engineering.issue: GL reconciliation is an accounting/finance specialty, clearly not in Cloud Engineer's 'does'.

Technology & Engineering.name: Produce rolling cloud spend forecast
Technology & Engineering.issue: Spend forecasting is a financial/analyst activity not in Cloud Engineer's 'does'; better owned by the Platform Engineering Lead or a finance analyst.

Technology & Engineering.name: Analyze budget-to-actual variance and drivers
Technology & Engineering.issue: Budget-to-actual variance analysis is a finance/analyst specialty outside Cloud Engineer's 'does'.

Technology & Engineering.name: Define cloud unit-cost metrics tied to business drivers
Technology & Engineering.issue: Altitude/specialty mismatch: defining unit-cost metrics is FinOps/Cloud Architect work; Enterprise Architect's 'does' is enterprise roadmap and portfolio rationalization, not metric definition.

Technology & Engineering.name: Calculate cost-per-transaction unit economics
Technology & Engineering.issue: Unit-economics calculation is a finance/analytics task not in Cloud Engineer's 'does'.

Technology & Engineering.name: Trend unit cost against efficiency targets
Technology & Engineering.issue: Trending/reporting of unit cost is an analyst/Data Engineer activity, not in Cloud Engineer's 'does'.

Change Management.name: Record compensating controls for elevated-risk changes
Change Management.issue: Risk Engineer in this division is an insurance loss-prevention/site-survey role (fire protection, business continuity surveys), not an IT change-risk owner; wrong specialty for owning IT compensating controls. IT Service Delivery Manager or Solution Architect fits better.
